verdict.rationale: Expensify documents some automation that runs without user action: finalized reports export automatically to QuickBooks Online (expensify-docs-7), SmartScan extracts receipt data automatically in real time (expensify-docs-6, expensify-docs-18), and users can build workspace rules by asking the AI (expensify-docs-4). These are fixed, built-in automations rather than general user-defined background workflows or agents, and nothing shows how far the rules can be configured or triggered. Missing for 10: user-defined triggers or scheduled workflows, autonomous agents acting on the user's behalf, documented rule-engine depth, and independent hands-on corroboration that background automations run reliably.
